user.description: Choose the entry type to add: Stock (manages custom stock items), a consumable type, or a custom type. Each type allows only one entry.
user.title: Select type

custom_type.description: Define a new consumable type, written into the user library (merged with built-in types). The type key allows only lowercase letters, digits and underscores, and must not duplicate an existing type.
custom_type.title: Custom consumable type

error.invalid_key: Type key allows only lowercase letters, digits and underscores
error.no_channel: Select at least one notification channel (system notification or entities)

options.scheduled: Scheduled (merge and push at a fixed time daily)

error.no_channel: Select at least one notification channel (system notification or entities)

add_item.title: Add stock
add_item.description: Pick a related consumable type (required) and how to add: from the library or a custom consumable.

consumable.title: Common consumable
consumable.description: Pick a consumable from the library and enter the quantity; name, type and unit inherit from the template.

custom_stock_item.title: Custom stock item
custom_stock_item.description: Define a custom stock item (name, type, model, unit, quantity, stock threshold; all required except meta). The ID is auto-generated as type+model and written into the user library, reusable as a common consumable.

edit_item.description: Edit stock item "{name}" (only quantity and stock threshold are editable; to change name/model, delete and re-add the item).
edit_item.title: Edit stock item

add_group.title: Add group
add_group.description: Choose the group kind: bound entities (link sensors/groups, evaluated by entity values) or custom consumable entity (self-built data, generates a diagnostic entity by elapsed used time).

custom_entity.title: Custom consumable entity
custom_entity.description: Build one consumable record: name (defaults to the current consumable entry), optionally bind a consumable of this type, added/replaced date, and an elapsed-used-time threshold. Saving creates a corresponding replace-status diagnostic entity. Binding a consumable makes the todo and diagnostic entity show that specific consumable.

group.title: Group settings
group.description: Set the group name and bound entities: manual multi-select + regex rule (optional). The regex rule matches current entity IDs at runtime; newly matched entities join the group automatically. Manual and regex are unioned. Optionally override the entry-level threshold to set a group-specific threshold.

data.name: Group name
data.entity_regex: Regex rule (optional): matches entity IDs at runtime; newly matched entities join automatically.

notification.title: Notification channels
notification.description: Configure alert notifications: channels are multi-select (HA system notification + notification entities). Push mode: realtime (send on trigger) or scheduled (merge all pending alerts into one notification at a fixed time every day, titled with the integration name). Message style: human wording (e.g. "Office temperature sensor low battery, please replace.") or raw value (e.g. "Office temperature sensor 18%").

data.customize: Customize notifications for this entry (off = fall back to global notification channels)
data.schedule_time: Scheduled push time (scheduled mode only; leave empty on an entry to follow the global time)

remove_items.description: Check the stock items to remove (multiple allowed).
remove_items.title: Remove stock items

select_item.description: Choose the stock item to edit.
select_item.title: Select stock item

threshold.description: Choose the threshold type, value, unit, and comparison (greater than / less than / equal).
threshold.title: Set threshold

bind_entity.name: Bind entity to consumable
bind_entity.description: 将设备耗材实体绑定到耗材库中的耗材（显式指定 consumable_id 或关联库存项继承），写入对应类型条目的绑定列表；可选关联一个库存项。

consumable_id.name: Consumable ID
consumable_id.description: 要绑定的耗材（必填：显式指定或经关联库存项继承）

group_id.name: Target group
group_id.description: Target binding group ID to write into; leave empty for the default group (auto-created if none)

unbind_entity.name: Unbind entity
unbind_entity.description: Remove an entity's binding to a consumable (undo a mis-binding).

query_binding.name: Query bindings
query_binding.description: Query the binding relationships between entities and consumables (filter by entity, consumable, or stock item). Returns only the entity↔consumable mapping; does not query device-registry info (manufacturer / model / area).

add_consumable.name: Add consumable to user library
add_consumable.description: Add a consumable to the local user library (config/.consumable_manager/user_library.json, atomic write). The consumable ID is auto-generated from type + model, e.g. filter_hepa13; conflicts link the built-in entry or append a short hash.

model.name: Model
model.description: Model number used to derive the consumable ID

unit.name: Unit
unit.description: Unit of measurement (e.g. 个, 片, 毫升)

meta.name: Specs
meta.description: Optional specs as a JSON object

add_type.name: Add custom type
add_type.description: Add a custom consumable type to the local user library (config/.consumable_manager/user_library.json, atomic write). The type key allows only lowercase letters, digits and underscores and must not duplicate an existing type (new-only semantics); threshold fields follow the built-in type schema.

type_key.name: Type key
type_key.description: Type key (lowercase letters, digits, underscores; must be unique)

default_threshold_type.name: Default threshold type
default_threshold_type.description: Default threshold type for the new type

query_data.name: Query data
query_data.description: Query any data of this integration; data_type is required. group_data can be refined by the filters below; other types return full data.

data_type.name: Data type
data_type.description: stock stock entries / type_entry consumable type entries / group_data group entity data / types type metadata / consumables consumables

consumable_type.name: Consumable type
consumable_type.description: Applies to group_data / consumables only: filter by consumable type (e.g. filter)

entry_id.name: Entry
entry_id.description: Applies to group_data only: pick the integration entry to query (dropdown of added entries)

group_entity.name: Group
group_entity.description: Applies to group_data only: pick the group to query (select its corresponding entity)

triggered_only.name: Triggered only
triggered_only.description: Applies to group_data only: only return groups with triggered members

adjust_stock.name: Adjust stock
adjust_stock.description: Increase or decrease the quantity of a stock item (picked from the stock item selector).
